name: King Li of Zhou
contribution: Estimated dates of his reign are 877–841 BC or 857–842 BC.
legacy: To pay for his pleasures and vices, this person raised taxes and caused misery among his subjects.

checks.lead: King Li of Zhou (died in 828 BC) (Chinese: 周厲王; pinyin: Zhōu Lì Wáng), also known as King Fen of Zhou (周汾王), personal name Ji Hu, was a king of the Zhou dynasty of China. Estimated dates of his reign are 877–841 BC or 857–842 BC (Cambridge History of Ancient China).
